result.question: What did Elisha say the officer who did not believe him would not do?

readings.answer: He would not eat any of it.
readings.support: you will not eat any of it

assessments.reason: Elisha’s words are “you will not eat any of it,” where “it” clearly refers to the foretold flour and barley, matching the key’s meaning.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says the officer would “not eat any of it,” referring to the flour and barley in the prophecy.
